title: Customer Discovery Conversation
description: Practice making discovery choices and see how each decision changes the conversation.
instruction: Choose the response that best advances the conversation. Review the feedback, then continue until you reach an outcome.

nodes.title: The customer describes inconsistent connectivity across several locations.
nodes.speaker: Operations Director
nodes.body: They say the issue is creating interruptions, but they have not yet explained which workflows are affected or how often the problem occurs.

choices.text: Ask which business processes are disrupted when connectivity drops.
choices.feedback: This connects the technical symptom to operational impact and gives you evidence for prioritization.

choices.text: Immediately explain the features of your recommended solution.
choices.feedback: You introduced a solution before establishing enough context. The conversation can recover, but you still need to uncover impact.

nodes.title: The customer says outages delay mobile staff and create manual rework.
nodes.speaker: Operations Director
nodes.body: They estimate the disruption happens several times each week, especially at two high-volume locations.

choices.text: Ask what improvement would make the project successful and how they would measure it.
choices.feedback: You moved from pain to measurable success criteria, which gives the opportunity a clear business outcome.

choices.text: Ask for their budget before clarifying what success looks like.
choices.feedback: Budget matters, but asking too early can narrow the conversation before value and success criteria are clear.

nodes.title: The customer asks why those features matter for their environment.
nodes.speaker: Operations Director
nodes.body: You have an opportunity to reconnect the conversation to their business situation.

choices.text: Acknowledge the question, then ask which workflows are most affected by the interruptions.
choices.feedback: Good recovery. You brought the discussion back to customer impact before continuing the solution conversation.

choices.text: Continue describing additional features and technical capabilities.
choices.feedback: The conversation stayed product-led and never established a strong connection to measurable customer value.

outcomes.title: Clear business case
outcomes.body: You connected the problem to operational impact and defined measurable success criteria before moving toward a solution.
outcomes.summary: The next conversation can focus on solution fit, stakeholders, constraints, and a credible path to value.

outcomes.title: Opportunity needs more discovery
outcomes.body: You uncovered real impact, but the conversation shifted toward commercial constraints before success criteria were fully defined.
outcomes.summary: Revisit desired outcomes and decision criteria before positioning the solution.

outcomes.title: Product-led conversation
outcomes.body: The customer heard features, but the discussion never established enough business context to make the recommendation compelling.
outcomes.summary: Restart with questions that reveal workflows, consequences, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
